subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.prompt:
The smallest level of organization in a multicellular organism is the
A) cell
B) organ
C) organ system
D) organism

Order from smallest to largest:
A) organ, cell, tissue
B) cell, tissue, organ
C) tissue, organ, cell
D) organ, tissue, cell

steps: Cells form tissues, which form organs.

items.prompt:
A group of similar cells doing a job is a
A) tissue
B) organ system
C) organism
D) molecule

steps: A tissue is similar cells with a shared function.

items.prompt:
The heart is an example of a(n)
A) cell
B) tissue
C) organ
D) organ system

steps: The heart is an organ made of tissues.

items.prompt:
The circulatory system is an example of a(n)
A) organ system
B) cell
C) tissue
D) single organ

steps: The circulatory system is organs working together.

items.prompt:
The digestive and circulatory systems interact because
A) the digestive system provides nutrients and the circulatory system delivers them
B) they never interact
C) they are the same organ
D) neither has a job
items.answer: A) the digestive system provides nutrients and the circulatory system delivers them

steps: The systems interact to nourish the body.

items.prompt:
A damaged organ can affect the whole organism because
A) its system cannot work well, and systems interact to keep the organism alive
B) organs are not connected to anything
C) the organism has no systems
D) organs do nothing
items.answer: A) its system cannot work well, and systems interact to keep the organism alive

steps: A failed organ weakens its interacting systems.

items.prompt:
The correct full hierarchy for the heart is
A) muscle cell, heart muscle tissue, heart, circulatory system, organism
B) organism, organ, cell
C) tissue, cell, organ
D) organ system, cell only
items.answer: A) muscle cell, heart muscle tissue, heart, circulatory system, organism

steps: Cell to tissue to organ to system to organism.
